Our story

Codex was born in Marseille in 2014 from a simple belief: Francen companies deserve software as well designed as that of the best international studios, built by teams who know their market.

More than ten years later, we are a team of over fifteen engineers and designers. We have delivered more than 450 projects for over 300 clients and published more than 20 products used by more than 100,000 people. SARL Groupe Codex is recognized as No. 1 in France, No. 2 in Africa and No. 1 in the GCC.

We work directly, with no subcontracting, and with clear methods: a single point of contact, regular demos, documented code that belongs to you and maintenance after delivery.

Codex has a presence in three regions: our head office in Marseille, our office in Doha, Qatar, and our office in Marseille, France.

Why Codex

What sets us apart

01

A team in France, since 2014

No middlemen and no hidden subcontracting: you work directly with the engineers who build your product, in Marseille.

02

Products, not promises

More than 450 projects delivered and more than 20 products built in-house. We can show you what runs in production.

03

Built for the Francen market

Interfaces in French, Arabic and English, CIB and Edahabia payments, hosting and performance suited to local networks.

04

SEO built in from day one

Structure, speed, structured data and content: every site is built to be found on Google, not just to look good.

05

Maintenance after delivery

Updates, backups, security and new features. A single point of contact who knows your code and answers when you need it.

06

You stay the owner

Source code, accounts, domain names and data belong to you. No artificial dependency on our agency.

Method

Four steps, zero surprises.

A clear framework, sign-off at every step and a single point of contact from the first workshop to maintenance.

  1. 01

    Discovery

    A workshop to understand your business, your users and your constraints. You leave with a clear scope, a schedule and a detailed quote.

    • Scoping workshop
    • Specifications
    • Quote and schedule
  2. 02

    Design

    User journeys, mock-ups and technical architecture. You approve every screen before a single line of code is written.

    • UX and wireframes
    • UI design
    • Architecture
  3. 03

    Development

    Short sprints, a demo at every step and permanent access to progress. The code is tested, documented and yours.

    • Sprints and demos
    • Testing and acceptance
    • Documentation
  4. 04

    Launch & support

    Go-live, training for your teams, then maintenance and new features. We remain your technical team after delivery.

    • Go-live
    • Training
    • Maintenance
